backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/faults.rs:466 — `category: req.category` is copied from the create-fault request into CreateFault with no enum/allowlist validation, so a tenant can persist an arbitrary category string (e.g. `=cmd|'/c calc'!A1`, or one containing `,` / CRLF). That string flows through the by_category GROUP BY aggregate (crates/db fault repo) into the unescaped CSV cell above, giving a stored CSV formula-injection / column-spill vector when a manager opens the exported report in Excel/LibreOffice.

backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/market_pricing.rs:459 — `list_regions(org_id).await.unwrap_or_default()` swallows any DB error into an empty region list, so a transient DB failure is indistinguishable from 'no regions configured'.

backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/market_pricing.rs:471 — `get_market_comparables(...).await.unwrap_or_default()` similarly turns a DB error into zero comparables; the downstream generate_statistical_pricing then silently falls back to the size-based estimate (market_pricing.rs:744) and returns a fabricated confidence, so a money-relevant pricing recommendation can be computed on empty data caused by an error while presenting as authoritative — the failure is neither surfaced to the caller nor logged as an error.
